descriptive_title: Kindergarten Mathematics: Demonstrations — Collecting and Displaying Data (A8.1-A8.4)
short_description: A 5-day Ontario Kindergarten unit on data demonstrations (A8.1-A8.4) framed around 'Data Detectives' — Detective Dot the Sorting Squirrel and Tally the Tally Cat. Sorting, counting, pictographs, and a capstone class data investigation.
long_description: Children spend a focused week as Junior Data Detectives. Day 1 introduces sorting by attribute. Day 2 counts data with tallies. Day 3 builds pictographs. Day 4 reads pictographs (most/fewest/equal). Day 5 closes with a child-chosen class data investigation. Each lesson includes an expanded_walkthrough.
what_is_included: 5 fully-scripted lesson plans with 50-minute durations and 250 minutes of total teaching time
5 student worksheets aligned to each lesson

10 printable teacher manipulatives plus 2 character puppets: sorting mats, paper button tokens (60), tally chart templates (6), pictograph template, class question cards (12), capstone template, mixed object tokens (60), class wall chart, data anchor chart, detectives poster, plus stick-puppet variants of Detective Dot and Tally
1 end-of-unit reflection sheet with 5 self-assessment prompts
1 four-row summative rubric covering A8.1-A8.4 across 4 levels
1 summative-administration guide tying the rubric to Lesson 5 capstone
Junior Data Detective certificate (one per child)
Detailed expanded walkthroughs covering common misconceptions
Differentiation tracks built into every lesson
target_buyer: Ontario Kindergarten teachers covering the A8.1-A8.4 cluster — sorting, counting, displaying, and reading data.
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: CRA progression. Sorting and tallying are concrete; pictographs are representational; data interpretation is the early-abstract layer. Lesson 5 capstone integrates all four expectations through a child-chosen class survey.
